question_text: Where does machine learning improve compiler optimization decisions?

ranking.answer_fit_rationale: Directly answers where ML improves compiler decisions: tensor program generation uses evolutionary search guided by a learned cost model and a task scheduler to choose high-performance implementations across hardware targets.
ranking.interestingness_rationale: It shows ML not just selecting a single pass parameter but steering a large compiler search space for deep-learning operators, making it useful for explaining modern learned autotuning and tensor compiler scheduling.
ranking.overall_rationale: Best fit because it combines a top systems venue, strong citation signal, public PDF access, and concrete performance results across CPU, ARM CPU, and GPU targets.

title: Ansor: Generating High-Performance Tensor Programs for Deep Learning
